notes.title: Knowledge
notes.selectToCreate: Select text and create a note

notes.knowledgeVaultScopedExportEmpty: This folder has nothing to export
notes.knowledgeVaultManifestInvalid: Could not read the ReadAny manifest in this folder
notes.knowledgeVaultConflictToast: Export conflicts found. Resolve them before exporting again.
notes.knowledgeVaultConflictDescription: These files changed after the last ReadAny export. Export stopped so your edits are not overwritten.

notes.knowledgeVaultImportSelectFolder: Choose a knowledge vault folder to import
notes.knowledgeVaultImportManifestMissing: This folder has no ReadAny manifest. Export from ReadAny first.
notes.knowledgeVaultImportUpToDate: No external changes found in this knowledge vault
notes.knowledgeVaultImportReadyDetailWithTempl: {{documentCount}} document changes and {{templateCount}} card template changes can be applied
notes.knowledgeVaultImportNoApplicableChanges: No changes can be applied automatically. Check missing or unreadable files.
notes.knowledgeVaultImportFailed: Failed to import knowledge vault changes
notes.knowledgeVaultImportApplyFailed: Failed to apply knowledge vault changes
notes.knowledgeVaultImportDescription: ReadAny previews folder changes first, then writes them back to the local knowledge base only after confirmation.
notes.knowledgeVaultImportSafeHint: Nothing is written back to ReadAny until you confirm.
notes.knowledgeVaultImportConflictSafeHint: Conflicted documents will not be applied. Resolve them manually before importing again.

knowledgeVaultImportResolution.manual_merge: Recommended: keep the current ReadAny version, merge the external file manually, then import again.
knowledgeVaultImportResolution.remove_duplicate: Recommended: delete or rename the duplicate ReadAny export file, then import again.
knowledgeVaultImportResolution.restore_missing: Recommended: restore the missing file, or export from ReadAny again before importing.
knowledgeVaultImportResolution.restore_readable: Recommended: make the file readable or export again, then import again.
knowledgeVaultImportResolution.manual_review: Recommended: review this external file, resolve it, then import again.
knowledgeVaultImportResolution.keep_local_template: Recommended: keep the local template; export again if you want the external manifest to match it.
